_meta.name: Parent Observation
_meta.respondent: parent_1 or parent_2, each completes separately via own link
_meta.scoring: NOT added to Final_c. Parent_c = mean of EARLY_BEHAVIOUR, CURRENT_BEHAVIOUR, MULTIPLE_INTELLIGENCE and TEACHER_FEEDBACK evidence for cluster c scaled 0-100. If two parents answer, average and show the gap between them. Outputs: alignment gap, hidden talents, expectation gap, income worry per cluster, openness. See sections 6.5 and 11 of the scoring document.
_meta.privacy: Never show one parent's answers to the other parent or to the student without recorded consent. Show only summaries.
_meta.fairness: Do not use the child's gender to interpret any item. Reject any rule that converts parent answers into a career decision; they are context only.
